title: Turkey Breast Fajitas with Tzatziki
ingredients: 1.5 lbs turkey breast tenderloins, sliced into thin fajita strips
2 bell peppers (1 red, 1 yellow), thinly sliced
1 tbsp chili powder, 1.5 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp oregano
1 cup Greek yogurt tzatziki sauce (0% Greek yogurt, grated cucumber, garlic, dill, lemon juice)
Fresh cilantro and pickled jalapeños for serving
instructions: Toss sliced turkey breast strips with half the olive oil, lime juice, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat. Sear the turkey strips in a single layer for 4–5 minutes until browned and cooked through; transfer to a plate.
In the same blistering skillet, add remaining olive oil, sliced bell peppers, and red onion. Char-sauté for 4–5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Return turkey to the skillet, toss together for 1 minute, and serve in warm tortillas topped generously with chilled cucumber-dill tzatziki and cilantro.
